name: Dan Jeffries
office: La Cañada Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Dan Jeffries has served on the La Cañada Unified School District Governing Board since 2013, including two terms as board president. He works as an assistant city attorney in Los Angeles, where he has been a prosecutor for nearly four decades. He says the district's top goals are keeping teachers and maintaining academic success while supporting students. He supports high academic standards and says students need more than strong test scores.

sentences.text: Dan Jeffries has served on the La Cañada Unified School District Governing Board since 2013, including two terms as board president.
He works as an assistant city attorney in Los Angeles, where he has been a prosecutor for nearly four decades.
He says the district's top goals are keeping teachers and maintaining academic success while supporting students.
He supports high academic standards and says students need more than strong test scores.

items.text: On the board, he has helped navigate teacher contract negotiations and the rollout of Common Core standards. He has also advocated regarding a state funding formula the district says underfunds it. He backed the June 2026 bond measure Measure LCF, writing that it was put on the ballot to bring schools to current health and educational standards.
